title: Begin under the Name before anything else
summary: This meets the tired mind that wants relief before orientation. The opening places everything under the One, Truth, and the Guru's grace before any other claim is allowed to speak.
takeaway: Begin under the Name before asking for relief.
lifeApplication: When weariness makes you grab for fixes, place the mind under the Name first. Let the One re-order the room before you decide what comes next.

source.shortMeaning: The opening places the heart under the One, Truth, and the Guru's grace.
source.lifeApplication: When weariness scatters you, begin again under the Name before reaching for relief.

evidence.coreClaim: The opening places the heart under the One, Truth, and the Guru's grace.
evidence.turn: Place the mind's trust in the Guru as cooling shelter.
evidence.practicalImplication: When weariness makes you grab for fixes, place the mind under the Name first. Let the One re-order the room before you decide what comes next.
